name: Tameshi
description: A Moonfolk futurist wizard from Kamigawa who studied how kami bridge the mortal and spirit realms and developed the Reality Chip.

description_citations.text: "Tameshi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Satoru assigns Kaito an off-list job: steal the schematics of the moonfolk Futurist Tameshi.
timeline.quote: I want you to bring me the schematics.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito learns Tameshi has moved his research to the Boseiju District and enlists his sister Eiko as a diplomat to guide him.
timeline.quote: Kaito lifted his head to find his sister standing several feet away.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko turns back at the river, and Kaito crosses alone and finds Tameshi's makeshift laboratory with a caged something.
timeline.quote: Not a box—a cage . And there was something trapped inside.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi ambushes Kaito and they fight with Tameshi's origami staff; Kaito pins Tameshi's throat with the staff.
timeline.quote: until he managed to pull the rod against his opponent's throat.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko stops Kaito from strangling Tameshi.
timeline.quote: "Kaito, what are you doing? Let him go!"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi recognizes Kaito's crane drone and reveals that Katsumasa was his mentor and that they designed it together.
timeline.quote: "He was my mentor.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: The caged object turns out to be a metal tanuki robot, which Eiko recognizes as resembling the animal she saw.
timeline.quote: "This robot is almost identical to the animal I saw."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi explains the light was a unique kami being born, embodying the emperor's bond with Kyodai, and that he built the prototype to protect it.
timeline.quote: "The light you saw was a kami being born.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko and Tameshi argue over whether his research endangers the kami and the merge gates, and Eiko demands it be destroyed.
timeline.quote: "Your research—it needs to be destroyed."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Five Hyozan Reckoners led by Nari arrive with Satoru's channeler, revealing they were watching Kaito and that the job was a setup to find Tameshi.
timeline.quote: He hoped you'd lead us to Tameshi."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko breaks free and the siblings fight the Reckoners back to back while Tameshi fails to make the kami merge with the robot.
timeline.quote: "What happened to 'no weapons'?"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: The Order of Jukai arrives and battles the Reckoners, letting the group escape with the kami.
timeline.quote: The Order of Jukai had arrived.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi reveals he stalled and sent a drone to summon the Order of Jukai, and Eiko offers him a deal to abandon the research.
timeline.quote: I was stalling, waiting for the Order of Jukai to turn up.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi gives Kaito his tanuki drone and departs to clear his lab.
timeline.quote: "Take it. It's far better than that outdated crane you've been holding onto."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Using a noise suppressor, Eiko tells Kaito that Tameshi was seen meeting a man with a metal arm in the Undercity.
timeline.quote: Tameshi was seen meeting with a man in the Undercity. A man with a metal arm.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito decides to trust his sister enough to investigate and spy on his best friend.
timeline.quote: Kaito believed in his sister enough to follow the trail.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: For weeks Kaito tails Tameshi on Otawara and finds he is hiding secret deals and a secret project.
timeline.quote: And he'd watched the unregulated drones leave the compound and head straight for the Towashi Undercity.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: In Tameshi's office Kaito finds a coded message to meet in the Undercity that night and a blueprint of a strange device.
timeline.quote: The meeting was happening tonight, and soon

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito tracks Tameshi to the Undercity docks and sends Himoto into a warehouse laboratory.
timeline.quote: Silently, she flew toward the warehouse.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds Tameshi mortally wounded by a metal arm, bleeding in the corner of the burning warehouse.
timeline.quote: The fabric of his robes had been slashed across the middle, clawed by a metal arm.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tameshi admits that lying to Kaito was his worst mistake.
timeline.quote: "I—I've made so many mistakes. But lying to you was the worst of them."

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tameshi dies after whispering the name Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret," Tameshi whispered like he was breaking a spell. And then he was gone.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito uses Tameshi's key card to enter the lab and finds kami being drained of their essence.
timeline.quote: There were dozens of them—alive, but shriveled and dull, as if their very essence was being sucked out of them.

citation.work: Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance
citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: On Kamigawa Jin-Gitaxias experiments on kami and devises a way to compleat a planeswalker without removing their soul.
timeline.quote: he successfully devised a way to compleat a planeswalker without removing their soul.

citation.work: Jin-Gitaxias
citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito's spark ignites when he contacts the kami Himoto while stealing Tameshi's work.
timeline.quote: Kaito's planeswalker spark ignited when he came into contact with the kami

citation.work: Kaito Shizuki
citation.text: "Kaito Shizuki", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tameshi researches kami to discover what lies behind the merge gates.
timeline.quote: was researching kami to discover what is behind the merge gates

citation.work: Merge gate
citation.text: "Merge gate", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tameshi discovers a way to connect tech and kami.
timeline.quote: The Futurist prodigy Tameshi had discovered a way to connect tech and kami

citation.work: Saiba Futurists
citation.text: "Saiba Futurists", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tameshi apprentices under Katsumasa and makes origami drones to house kami, later developing technology letting kami merge into robot bodies.
timeline.quote: he later built on this design to develop a technology that made it possible for Kami to merge into robot bodies

citation.work: Tameshi
citation.text: "Tameshi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tameshi gives a drone to Kaito Shizuki.
timeline.quote: He gave one of the drones to his friend, Kaito Shizuki

citation.work: Tameshi
citation.text: "Tameshi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito meets Tameshi in Jukai Forest; Tameshi becomes his mentor and best friend for nine years.
timeline.quote: Tameshi became the young planeswalker's mentor and best friend

citation.work: Tameshi
citation.text: "Tameshi", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eiko warns Kaito that Tameshi trades illegal merge studies with Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Kaito's sister Eiko warned him that Tameshi was involved in trading illegal merge studies

citation.work: Tameshi
citation.text: "Tameshi", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito discovers Tameshi was secretly working with Jin-Gitaxias, who kills Tameshi after getting what he needed.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias killed Tameshi.

citation.work: Tameshi
citation.text: "Tameshi", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: initially opposes his research, then spares him in exchange for ending it

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.
